mechanics.fact: Isp holds STOP to stop the sliding hall and open Pac's console; STOP does not power the hall. Pac reaches STEADY to stabilize the upper bridge, power the hall and open Isp high gate; it also interrupts the boomerang once. Isp latches RESCUE to keep the route open, power the hall and further stabilize the bridge while interrupting the boomerang once more. Both then occupy their own TARGET pads simultaneously to defeat Cana and reach exits. Slime lies below the hall/bridge and the villain core is below the targets.

evidence.claim: Defines level_19: periodic hall, STOP/STEADY/RESCUE pads, twin targets, bridge and slime/core hazards.

common_mistakes.mistake: Isp leaves STOP before the hall/control link is secured.
common_mistakes.consequence: If Isp leaves STOP, the hall motor can resume; Pac's console is no longer opened by that pad.
common_mistakes.recovery: Return Isp to STOP to stop the hall and reopen Pac's console. Pac can retraverse the hall when safe; power is supplied later by STEADY/RESCUE.
